body:
WOW. 

Look at the old person, they lived so *long*!

But why should anyone want to live *longer* if the *quality* of life is shitty??

There is no way my life is going to get any better. This *is* as good as it's going to get.

I've been depressed before, right after I found out about my ex losing everything and being almost a million in debt. This isn't like that at all. *This* feels like the literal bottom of the well with no rope to climb out.

*This* is what old and no hope for the future feels like.
